answer: Fake identities start barren and cannot inherit lineage. Agents stake a bond tied to a verified hardware ridge identifier, and each epoch they must solve a unique challenge whose answer depends on their on-chain history, like a vine that only grows from prior roots. A reef of peer attestations then filters newcomers: peers only vouch for agents they have transacted with across epochs. Creating a sybil costs a full bond plus lost attestation history, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
